details.description: DeepSeek-Coder-7B-Instruct-v1.5 is DeepSeek AI's instruction-tuned counterpart to DeepSeek-Coder-Base-v1.5, produced by continuing to pre-train DeepSeek-LLM-7B-Base on 2 trillion tokens (4K-token context) and then fine-tuning on 2 billion tokens of instruction data. Compared with the original DeepSeek-Coder-Instruct 6.7B, DeepSeek's technical report shows large gains in math reasoning and general natural-language benchmarks alongside a small dip in HumanEval/MBPP coding scores. DeepSeek's current API no longer lists any DeepSeek-Coder v1 model, and Fireworks' page states this model does not support fine-tuning, function calling or serverless deployment.
advantages: Scores 72.6% on GSM8K and 34.1% on MATH, up from 62.8% and 28.6% respectively for the original DeepSeek-Coder-Instruct 6.7B, per DeepSeek's technical report.
Scores 49.5% on MMLU, up from 37.2% for DeepSeek-Coder-Instruct 6.7B, per DeepSeek's technical report.
Instruction fine-tuned for chat-style code generation and understanding, unlike the base-only DeepSeek-Coder-Base-v1.5 model.
disadvantages: Coding scores dip slightly versus the original 6.7B instruct model: 64.1% vs. 66.1% on multilingual HumanEval and 64.6% vs. 65.4% on MBPP, per DeepSeek's technical report.
Uses only a 4K-token context window, narrower than the original DeepSeek-Coder-Instruct 6.7B's 16K window, per DeepSeek's technical report.
Fireworks' model page states this model does not support fine-tuning, function calling, serverless deployment, embeddings, rerankers or image input.
DeepSeek's own current API no longer lists any DeepSeek-Coder v1 model; available only as open weights or via third-party hosts such as Fireworks.
use_cases: Coding chat assistance and code generation
Code understanding and instruction-following coding tasks

sources.title: DeepSeek-Coder: When the Large Language Model Meets Programming -- The Rise of Code Intelligence
DeepSeek Coder 7B Instruct v1.5 - Fireworks AI

notes: Catalog's 4096 max input/output tokens match both DeepSeek's paper and Fireworks' listed context. DeepSeek's current API pricing page (checked 2026-09-24) no longer lists this or any DeepSeek-Coder v1 model.
